sections.label: ASEAN extradition and air encounters
sections.summary: This year ASEAN finalised the Model ASEAN Extradition Treaty, work will begin on an ASEAN Extradition Treaty, and ASEAN Defence Ministers adopted Guidelines for Air Military Encounters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: More specifically, this year, under ASEAN, we finalised the Model ASEAN Extradition Treaty, and work will soon begin on an ASEAN Extradition Treaty.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: In addition, the ASEAN Defence Ministers adopted the Guidelines for Air Military Encounters.

sections.label: ASEAN cybersecurity and South China Sea
sections.summary: ASEAN adopted a Leaders' Statement on Cybersecurity Cooperation, Singapore announced a cybersecurity centre, and a Single Draft Negotiating Text for the Code of Conduct was formulated.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: ASEAN, for the first time, adopted a Leaders’ Statement on Cybersecurity Cooperation at the 32nd ASEAN Summit in April this year, and Singapore announced the ASEAN-Singapore Cybersecurity Centre for Excellence in September this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: A key milestone of these three years was the formulation of a Single Draft Negotiating Text for the Code of Conduct in the South China Sea.

sections.label: ASEAN economic integration and smart cities
sections.summary: ASEAN Leaders committed to conclude RCEP in 2019, emphasised economic integration through single window, self-certification and e-commerce schemes, and established the ASEAN Smart Cities Network.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: ASEAN Leaders committed to conclude the RCEP in 2019, next year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We emphasised closer economic integration through agreements on the ASEAN Single Window, the ASEAN-wide Self-Certification scheme and the ASEAN E-Commerce scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Without getting into the details, the point is that these initiatives will facilitate cross-border flows of goods and services within ASEAN, especially as businesses increasingly go digital, and this will ultimately enhance intra-ASEAN trade and opportunities for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) to service the expanding consumer market in ASEAN.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We established our flagship project, the ASEAN Smart Cities Network.

sections.label: Myanmar invites ASEAN humanitarian centre
sections.summary: Myanmar invited the ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance to send a needs assessment team to Rakhine State to facilitate repatriation, and ASEAN agreed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Myanmar has invited the ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management to despatch a needs assessment team to Rakhine State in order to facilitate the repatriation, and ASEAN has agreed to do so.

sections.label: US-DPRK summit hosted by Singapore
sections.summary: The US President and DPRK leader held a summit on 12 June, and Singapore hosted it because both sides asked, though it did not volunteer.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: The first was the Summit between US President Donald Trump and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) leader Kim Jong Un on 12 June this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: But the point I want to drive home is this: that we are a small country, but we can be counted on to deliver when necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We did not volunteer to host the Summit between the US and DPRK, but we were asked by both sides, and when we were asked, we could not say no.

sections.label: Pedra Branca and High Speed Rail
sections.summary: Singapore welcomed Malaysia's decision to discontinue its applications on the 2008 Pedra Branca Judgment, and agreed with Malaysia to suspend HSR construction until 31 May 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: On Pedra Branca, we welcomed Malaysia's decision to discontinue their applications for both a revision and interpretation of the International Court of Justice's original 2008 Judgment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: On the High Speed Rail (HSR) project, we reached an agreement with Malaysia to suspend the construction of the HSR up till 31 May 2020.

sections.label: Retreat agreements and MAS-Indonesia pact
sections.summary: At the Retreat, a Bilateral Investment Treaty and six other agreements were signed, plus a MAS-Indonesia central bank agreement providing a US$10 billion package.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: At the Retreat, we signed a Bilateral Investment Treaty and six other agreements across a diverse range of sectors, including tourism, the digital economy and culture.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Our Leaders also announced a bilateral agreement between the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) and the central bank of Indonesia, and this bilateral agreement has since been signed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: This bilateral agreement provides for a US$10 billion package, that comprises a local currency swap and a US dollar repurchase agreement to support monetary and financial stability, and to strengthen investor confidence in our region.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Another initiative announced at the Retreat was the "RISING Fellowship".

sections.label: Deng Xiaoping visit anniversary
sections.summary: This year marks the 40th anniversary of Mr Deng Xiaoping's visit to Singapore on 12 November 1978.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: This year is, in fact, an especially significant year for Singapore-China relations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: It is the 40th anniversary of Mr Deng Xiaoping's visit to Singapore on 12 November 1978.

sections.label: Singapore-China FTA upgrade
sections.summary: During Premier Li's visit last week, the Singapore-China Free Trade Agreement was substantially upgraded.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: During Premier Li’s visit last week, we substantially, and I make that point, substantially upgraded the Singapore-China Free Trade Agreement.

sections.label: CCI New Land Sea Corridor
sections.summary: CCI now has a New International Land Sea Trade Corridor (ILSTC).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: CCI now has a New International Land Sea Trade Corridor (ILSTC).

sections.label: EU-Singapore FTA signing
sections.summary: Last month the Prime Minister signed the EU-Singapore Free Trade Agreement, which must be ratified in the European Parliament by May next year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Just last month, the Prime Minister signed the EU-Singapore Free Trade Agreement (FTA), and now we will have to work hard to make sure it is ratified in the European Parliament by May next year.

sections.label: Upcoming partnerships and MERCOSUR talks
sections.summary: Singapore looks forward to signing the Singapore-New Zealand Enhanced Partnership and upgraded ANZSCEP next year, and launched MERCOSUR-Singapore FTA negotiations in July.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: So, we now look forward to signing the Singapore-New Zealand Enhanced Partnership (EP) and the upgraded ANZSCEP next year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We have also launched the MERCOSUR-Singapore FTA negotiations in July this year.

sections.label: Eurasian Economic Union FTA talks
sections.summary: Singapore holds ongoing discussions on a Eurasian Economic Union-Singapore FTA, and the two represent the fifth and eighth largest economies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: They represent the fifth and eighth largest economies in the world.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We are also having ongoing and encouraging discussions on the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU)-Singapore FTA.

sections.label: CPTPP ratification and entry into force
sections.summary: Singapore ratified the CPTPP this year; with a combined market of 500 million people, it enters into force on 30 December this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Significantly, Singapore ratified the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement on the Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: With a combined market of 500 million people, CPTPP will enter into force on 30 December this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: In fact, if Members cast your minds back to January this year, and if I told you that the TPP minus the US, the remaining 11 partners, would agree to renegotiate and conclude the CPTPP, and that we would ratify and that it would come into force on 30 December 2018, you would have thought I was being completely unrealistic.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: It will produce substantial savings and improve market access for Singapore companies.

sections.label: Singapore's trust amid geopolitical turbulence
sections.summary: Even in times of significant geopolitical turbulence, Singapore has built up the precious asset called trust.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Even in times of significant geopolitical turbulence, Singapore has built up that very precious asset called "trust".

sections.label: Singapore-Indonesia DCA and extradition treaty
sections.summary: Singapore and Indonesia agreed on a Defence Cooperation Agreement and Extradition Treaty, signed before their leaders, but progress awaits Indonesia's political dynamics.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The Member has been in House long enough to remember that we had actually agreed with Indonesia on two agreements – Defence Cooperation Agreement (DCA) and an Extradition Treaty (ET).

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: They were both signed in the presence of the respective leaders, Prime Minister Lee and President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono of Indonesia.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: We will have to wait for the political dynamics within Indonesia as to whether Members are going to see any progress on those two bilateral agreements.

sections.label: Bilateral treaties and ASEAN extradition talks
sections.summary: The signed but unratified bilateral DCA and extradition treaty do not prevent negotiations for an ASEAN Extradition Treaty on different terms.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Now, if we look at a 10 by 10 extradition treaty, you can imagine the permutations and the lowest common multiple will be quite different from what you would have had in a bilateral Extradition Treaty.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: So, I think suffice to say without getting into details, our position is this – there is a bilateral DCA and bilateral ET which were signed and witnessed by our Leaders, but not yet ratified.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: We will wait and see what happens with that.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: That, however, does not mean we should not be able to proceed with negotiations for an ASEAN Extradition Treaty on different terms.

sections.label: Support for refugees from Singapore
sections.summary: Grassroots and NGO fundraising and support have been extended to refugees, and Singapore helped refugees in Bangladesh, including RSAF shipments.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: And even from Singapore, I think the Member would be aware that at the grassroots level, at the NGO level, there has been fundraising and there has been support extended to the refugees.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: We have also extended help directly to the refugees in Bangladesh.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: For instance, the Republic of Singapore Air Force (RSAF) conveyed a couple of shipments.

sections.label: Rakhine rebuilding and cash-for-work
sections.summary: India and China are helping build prefabricated homes in Rakhine State, where a labour shortage has led Myanmar to propose a cash-for-work programme for refugees.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Right now, for instance, I know India and China are helping with constructing prefabricated homes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: I know one problem which I have been informed of is that there is a lack of labour within Rakhine State to do rebuilding.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Therefore, there has been proposals by the Myanmar government to have a cash-for-work programme so that the refugees will be paid to rebuild and to engage in construction and reconstruction.

sections.label: China on Negotiating Text timing
sections.summary: China hopes for a first reading of the Negotiating Text next year and settlement within three years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Nevertheless, China has said that they hope that there will be a first reading of the Negotiating Text next year and they also hope that it can be settled in three years.

sections.label: Aid targeted to returning refugees
sections.summary: Singapore is prepared to send further consignments of aid and would consider targeting aid to refugees when they return.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: On further consignments of aid, yes, we are prepared to, but I would consider targeting the aid to the refugees when they return.

sections.label: RCEP progress, derailers, AIPA performance
sections.summary: RCEP talks showed substantial progress but no conclusion, leaders backed concluding in early 2019, elections are potential derailers, and Singapore MPs performed impressively at AIPA.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: On RCEP, the statement was very carefully crafted.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: We reported substantial progress on the negotiations for RCEP, in other words, not yet ready to declare conclusion.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: On the Member's question as to what are the chances of it being done next year, well, based on the Leaders' pronouncement last week, all of them indicated their support for it to be concluded in early 2019.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: On the Member's next question are there potential derailers, of course, there are potential derailers, including the fact that there are several elections next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: I just want to add that the performance by the Singapore Members of Parliament during AIPA, led by Deputy Speaker Mr Charles Chong and the team of Members of Parliament, was very impressive.
